recruitment_summary: The SSC CGL 2026 stands as the most significant bureaucratic recruitment drive in India for the 2026-27 fiscal year. This cycle integrates the new 'Live Capture' biometric attendance system and the revised Paper-I merit-mapping logic. This document serves as the absolute technical manual for all 34+ post categories under the CGL umbrella.

overview_extended.Organization_Full_Name: Staff Selection Commission, Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT)
overview_extended.Service_Classification: Group B (Gazetted), Group B (Non-Gazetted), Group C
overview_extended.Selection_Architecture: Computer Based Examination (Two Tiers) + DEST + Document Verification

post_encyclopedia_detailed.Name: Assistant Audit Officer (AAO)
post_encyclopedia_detailed.Department: Indian Audit & Accounts Dept under C&AG
post_encyclopedia_detailed.Job_Profile: The only Gazetted post in CGL. Involves assisting in financial/performance audits of Govt. departments. High traveling requirements. Responsibility includes verifying accounts and ensuring financial propriety.
post_encyclopedia_detailed.Promotion_Hierarchy: Audit Officer -> Sr. Audit Officer -> DAG

post_encyclopedia_detailed.Name: Assistant Section Officer (ASO)
post_encyclopedia_detailed.Job_Profile: Backbone of the Indian Secretariat. Located in New Delhi. Involves policy drafting, file processing, and assisting Under Secretaries. Minimal travel, high stability.
post_encyclopedia_detailed.Promotion_Hierarchy: Section Officer -> Under Secretary -> Deputy Secretary

post_encyclopedia_detailed.Name: Inspector (Income Tax)
post_encyclopedia_detailed.Job_Profile: Assessment and Non-Assessment work. Includes handling tax evasion cases, TDS verification, and search/seizure operations. High social prestige.

post_encyclopedia_detailed.Name: Sub Inspector (CBI)
post_encyclopedia_detailed.Job_Profile: Investigative fieldwork. Involves gathering intelligence, performing raids, and legal documentation. High pressure, 20% Extra Special Pay.

Quantitative_Aptitude_Micro_Topics: Arithmetic: Percentages (Successive/Formula), Ratio & Proportion (Proportionality/Partnership), Average (Weighted/Ages), Interest (SI/CI/Installments), Profit & Loss (Discount/Dishonest Dealer), Mixture & Alligation.
Algebra: Basic identities, Linear Equations, Quadratic Equations, Remainder Theorem.
Trigonometry: Ratios, Complementary Angles, Heights & Distances.
Mensuration: 2D (Area/Perimeter), 3D (Volume/Surface Area of Prisms, Pyramids, Spheres).
Statistics: Histogram, Frequency Polygon, Bar-diagram, Pie-chart, Mean/Median/Mode/Std Deviation.
General_Intelligence_Micro_Topics: Verbal: Analogy, Classification, Series, Coding-Decoding, Blood Relations, Direction Sense, Syllogism, Input-Output, Decision Making.
Non-Verbal: Mirror Image, Water Image, Paper Folding, Embedded Figures, Pattern Completion.
Critical_Reasoning: Statement & Assumptions, Course of Action, Cause & Effect, Strength of Arguments.
English_Language_Micro_Topics: Vocabulary: 5000+ Word Base, Synonyms/Antonyms (Contextual), One Word Substitution, Idioms (Origins/Usage), Phrasal Verbs.
Grammar: Tenses, Subject-Verb Agreement, Prepositions, Conjunctions, Articles, Noun/Pronoun Errors.
Comprehension: Narrative/Scientific Passages, Cloze Test (Advanced), Sentence Rearrangement (PQRS).

medical_manual_physical_standards.Visual_Standards: Color Blindness is acceptable for some posts (Auditor/Accountant) but strictly prohibited for Inspectors (CBIC/CBN/CBI).

faq_technical_section.Q: Can final year students apply for CGL 2026?
faq_technical_section.A: Yes, provided they acquire the essential qualification on or before the cutoff date (Expected 01-08-2026).

faq_technical_section.Q: Is there a change in Tier-II pattern for 2026?
faq_technical_section.A: The pattern remains consistent with 2025, but normalized weightage for Computer Knowledge has been increased for certain ministerial posts.

faq_technical_section.Q: How does the Live Photo Capture work?
faq_technical_section.A: Candidates must use a webcam or mobile camera via the SSC app. The background must be white, and eyes must be clearly visible without glasses/caps.

how_to_apply_master_guide: 1. Navigate to ssc.gov.in and complete the 'One Time Registration' (OTR) with Aadhaar verification.
2. Log in and select 'Combined Graduate Level Examination 2026' from the dashboard.
3. Fill in the 'Higher Educational Qualification' and 'Year of Passing'.
4. Give preferences for Exam Centers (3 choices within the same region).
5. Complete the 'Live Photograph' capture process as per Annexure-V.
6. Review the application preview for 'Spelling Errors' in Father's name or DOB.
7. Final Submit and make payment via BHIM UPI/Net Banking.
8. Download the application receipt and keep the 'Registration ID' for future reference.
